name: India Companies Act & SEBI Regulatory Compliance
description: Compliance framework for India Companies Act 2013, SEBI LODR (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Prohibition of Insider Trading (PIT), and Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC).

checklists.name: India Companies Act & SEBI Statutory Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Companies Act 2013 section compliance, SEBI LODR corporate governance, and PIT SDD rules.

items.statement: Structured Digital Database (SDD) logs all entries of UPSI sharing with non-editable timestamps and PAN numbers.
Material events under SEBI LODR Regulation 30 are disclosed to BSE/NSE within 24 hours of board determination.
Related Party Transactions (RPT) receive prior Audit Committee and Shareholder approvals per Companies Act Sec 188.
Annual secretarial compliance report (Form MR-3) and MCA e-filings are verified by a practicing Company Secretary.

reviewGates.name: SEBI & Secretarial Audit Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Company Secretary (CS) confirms that SDD logs, SEBI LODR filings, and Companies Act statutory records satisfy regulatory requirements.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the secretarial audit evidence confirm full compliance with SEBI and Companies Act 2013 regulations?
checklistIds: India Companies Act & SEBI Statutory Audit Checklist

obligationDefinitions.title: Trading window closures must be enforced during Unpublished Price Sensitive Information periods
obligationDefinitions.description: SEBI's Prohibition of Insider Trading regulations require the trading window to be closed for designated persons whenever Unpublished Price Sensitive Information exists; a lapse in enforcing the closure is a compliance failure independent of whether any actual trade occurred.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: The trading window closure is active and enforced for every declared UPSI period.

requiredEvidence.title: Trading window enforcement record
requiredEvidence.description: Record confirming the trading window was closed for designated persons during each UPSI period.
